summary: Tested Resend-integrated password reset flow (both backend + frontend) plus regression on login/dashboard. All 6 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend forgot-password page correctly shows amber fallback box with reset link when Resend cannot deliver (email_sent=false). Admin password was reset then restored to admin123.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1250 lines — should be split into modules (auth, qso, admin, wavelog, email) for maintainability

forgot_password: reset_link fallback exposes token in HTTP response. Acceptable for dev/simulation but should be gated by an env flag (e.g. DEV_MODE) so production never leaks tokens even if Resend fails
SENDER_EMAIL onboarding@resend.dev is Resend's test sender — Resend won't deliver to unverified recipients in test mode. Ensure production uses a verified domain
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI; use lifespan handlers
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 / F0ADMIN (verified logged in after tests)
seed_data_creation: None. Admin password reset then restored to admin123 to keep credentials valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset flow is stable: fallback mode returns reset_link when Resend can't deliver (e.g. admin@example.com). Frontend correctly renders 3 states (emailSent success, resetLink fallback, form). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py — 6 tests cover forgot-password (email+callsign+nonexistent), reset-password (valid, invalid token, token reuse), and login regression. Also verified /api/auth/me, /api/qso, /api/qso/stats/total, /api/admin/stats.
